title_zh: 先查周五场馆空档而不预订

scenario.label_zh: 询问活动场馆空档并约定核对周五
scenario.goal_zh: 说明预计观众人数和日期冲突，并约定查询周五场馆空档后再回复

context_zh: 活动筹办人与体育馆预订员讨论社区表演的可能日期。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Kofi
sentences.text: We're expecting attendance of about six hundred. Is the arena available on Saturday the twelfth?

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: It has enough seats, but there's a clash with a basketball tournament on that date.

sentences.speaker: Kofi
sentences.text: What about the evening before? Our performers could manage Friday.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: I'll need to check availability with the event manager. Friday isn't showing as confirmed either way.

sentences.speaker: Kofi
sentences.text: Please check that date and email me. Don't reserve anything yet.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: I will. You'll get an answer about Friday before we discuss a booking.

targets.sense_zh: 大型室内比赛或活动场馆
